Celebrity Spotlight

Fantasia

Press day ready. Camera ready. Hair by Derickus Crawford.

When it is press day, the hair has to hold up close. Fantasia's sleek short cut and her full glam were done by Derickus Crawford, the Master Stylist in the chair at Hera By Him.

The story

Look close at the two photos. First the sleek short cut in profile, burgundy leather jacket on, every line clean. Then the sculpted glam, straight to camera. Two angles, one standard. The finish is the whole point.

That is the work at the top of this page, and it is the work his followers watch as it happens on Instagram. It is not a stock photo and it is not a borrowed picture. It is his client, his hands, his finish.

✓The Same HandsThe hands that did Fantasia's press day glam are the hands waiting for you. Derickus Crawford himself, start to finish.

✓Your Look, Your PickSilk press, braids and protective styles, natural hair care, color and highlights, cuts and styling, weaves and extensions.

The story

She drove in from Virginia
for one haircut.

She had sat in plenty of chairs before she found this one. What she had never found was a stylist who treated the finish like the whole point. So she made the drive to Charlotte, sat down in Derickus's chair, and walked out with a cut she could not stop looking at.

That is the moment it clicks, client after client. The hair was never the problem. The chair was. Put a Master Stylist behind that chair, and the mirror starts telling a different story.

The reason why, in his own words

“Every style that leaves this salon runs through my hands, start to finish. I take my time because the finish is the whole point, the press, the parts, the polish. That is why a client will drive in from Virginia to sit here. If your hair matters to you, sit where it matters to the stylist.”
Derickus Crawford, Master Stylist

Before You Book

Bring the photo of the look you want. If you are not sure which service gets you there, call (704) 568 8771 before you book and the salon will point you to the right one. That way you sit down already knowing the chair, the service, and the finish you are getting.

My Word Is The Guarantee

Here is the deal, plain and simple. You sit in my chair, I do your hair, and when I turn you to the mirror, you have to love what you see. If you do not, say so right there, before you leave. I will rework it until you do. And if I still cannot get it where you want it, your next visit is on me. No fine print. No hard feelings. You came in to love your hair, and you are not leaving until the mirror says you do.

Derickus Crawford, Master Stylist
